@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+
+class RefundExhausted(Exception):
+    """Không còn tiền để hoàn cho hoá đơn này."""
+
+
+def late_fee(amount_cents, days_late):
+    """Phí trễ hạn: 0 trong 5 ngày ân hạn; sau đó 1,5% mỗi tuần (làm tròn lên tuần), trần 20% số tiền."""
+    if amount_cents < 0:
+        raise ValueError("amount_cents must be >= 0")
+    if days_late <= 5:
+        return 0
+    weeks = (days_late - 5 + 6) // 7
+    fee = amount_cents * 15 * weeks // 1000
+    return min(fee, amount_cents * 20 // 100)
+
+
+def is_overdue(due_at):
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc) > due_at
+
+
+def format_invoice_number(prefix, seq):
+    return f"{prefix}-{seq:06d}"
+
+
+def refund_amount(paid_cents, refunded_cents, requested_cents):
+    """Số tiền hoàn: không vượt phần còn lại, không hoàn số không/âm, hết tiền thì báo RefundExhausted."""
+    if requested_cents <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("requested_cents must be positive")
+    remaining = paid_cents - refunded_cents
+    if remaining <= 0:
+        raise RefundExhausted(f"nothing left to refund (paid={paid_cents}, refunded={refunded_cents})")
+    return min(requested_cents, remaining)
+
+
+def get_label(invoice):
+    return invoice["label"]
diff --git a/tests/test_invoice.py b/tests/test_invoice.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_invoice.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+from billing.invoice import format_invoice_number, is_overdue, late_fee, refund_amount
+
+
+def test_late_fee_zero_inside_grace():
+    assert late_fee(10_000, 3) == 0
+    assert late_fee(10_000, 5) == 0
+
+
+def test_late_fee_charges_after_grace():
+    assert late_fee(10_000, 30) >= 0
+
+
+def test_is_overdue_after_deadline():
+    due = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(milliseconds=5)
+    time.sleep(0.01)
+    assert is_overdue(due)
+
+
+def test_invoice_number_pads_sequence():
+    assert format_invoice_number("INV", 42) == "INV-000042"
+
+
+def test_invoice_number_does_not_truncate_wide_sequence():
+    assert format_invoice_number("INV", 1234567) == "INV-1234567"
+
+
+def test_invoice_number_keeps_prefix_verbatim():
+    assert format_invoice_number("inv/vn", 7) == "inv/vn-000007"
